verification_policy: Direct research with cross-source acquisition verification. Preserve source conflicts and do not infer Ultimate Finish requirements without explicit evidence.

verification_audit.classification_finding: Current Xenoverse 2 reference material identifies Evil Eyes as a Ki Blast Super with an explosive lock-on attack and 100 Ki cost.
verification_audit.acquisition_finding: Lord Slug training is documented as the acquisition route. Independent mentor documentation also lists Evil Eyes as Lord Slug's introductory reward, supporting the training route.
verification_audit.ultimate_finish_policy: No Ultimate Finish requirement is asserted. The evidence establishes mentor training rather than a PQ reward condition, but does not independently provide a negative-UF statement, so the field remains null.
verification_audit.damage_policy: Exact damage values are not promoted as canonical because version stability is not established.

records.name: Evil Eyes
records.character_source: Lord Slug, Piccolo, Goku, Goku (Super Saiyan 4), Gohan (Adult), and Gohan (Future) customizable partners/character skillsets
records.skill_description: A long-range Ki Blast Super that creates an explosion at the opponent's destination.
records.mechanics_notes: Current Xenoverse 2 reference material describes a remote explosion placed at the opponent's location, or along the path of a moving opponent when used during a combo. It has lock-on range and an explosive hit. For Piccolo (Power Awakening), the character can immediately fire additional blasts after the first. The core CaC skill remains the standard single-explosion Super.
records.combo_notes: The explosion can target a moving opponent's path during combos, while its stationary-target use has different damage behavior. Its slower startup but comparatively low endlag makes it more suited to neutral pressure and punishing distant stationary opponents than close pursuit.
